threshold: 99.8th percentile (higher order statistic) of maximum human validation-window logits
fit_data: baseline plus distinct MAGE and RAID development rows from the published calibration slice
test_data: reserved MAGE/RAID test slice; ELLIPSE and ICNALE learner essay cohorts
decision: Promote the English model only if the pooled English general-domain test has fewer than 1% human documents flagged (including suppressed), at least 50% machine documents signalled, and fewer than 1% human documents flagged in the ELLIPSE/ICNALE combined sample. Also publish stricter one-sided uncertainty bounds and per-source results. Neither promotion nor these research observations certify committee acceptance.
